plugins.name: clockmost-package
plugins.description: Scaffold, build and release Arch packages through git.clockmost.com/pkgs. Hardened CI (cargo-deny, cargo-vet, semgrep, trivy), the cargo-vet triage loop, and the pacman client setup.

plugins.name: project-conventions
plugins.description: Cross-project conventions: repo layout, trunk + PR branching, Conventional Commits, SemVer, a README that explains setup, and the per-language (Rust/Python/JS/shell) lint+format+CI baseline.
